```{r}
# Construction de la grille commune 
grille <- function(trajectoires) {
  total_time <- sum(sapply(trajectoires, function(tr) max(tr$t)))
  total_obs <- sum(sapply(trajectoires, function(tr) length(tr$t) - 1))
  h <- total_time / total_obs
  T_max <- max(sapply(trajectoires, function(tr) max(tr$t)))
  seq(0, T_max, by = h)
}

# Pont gamma multiples
pont_gamma_multi <- function(traj, a, t_fine) {
  tol <- 1e-10
  h <- diff(t_fine)[1]
  res <- list()
  for (i in seq_along(traj)) {
    tr <- traj[[i]]
    t_obs <- tr$t
    X_obs <- tr$X
    t_n <- max(t_obs)
    t_star <- t_fine[t_fine < t_n - tol]
    t_star <- c(t_star, t_n)
    K <- length(t_star)
    Y <- numeric(K)
    Y[1] <- X_obs[1]
    if (K > 2) {
      for (j in 2:(K-1)) {
        t_cible <- t_star[j]
        inter <- max(t_obs[t_obs <= t_cible])
        if (inter > t_star[j-1]) {
          t_inf <- inter
          x_inf <- X_obs[t_obs == inter]
        } else {
          t_inf <- t_star[j-1]
          x_inf <- Y[j-1]
        }
        t_sup <- min(t_obs[t_obs > t_cible])
        x_sup <- X_obs[t_obs == t_sup]
        y <- rbeta(1, a * (t_cible - t_inf), a * (t_sup - t_cible))
        Y[j] <- x_inf + (x_sup - x_inf) * y
      }
    }
    Y[K] <- X_obs[length(X_obs)]
    diff_Y <- diff(Y)
    dt <- diff(t_star)
    keep <- which(abs(dt - h) <= tol)
    diff_Y_iid <- diff_Y[keep]
    res[[i]] <- list(t_star = t_star, X_star = Y, diff_X = diff_Y, diff_X_iid = diff_Y_iid)
  }
  return(res)
}

```

```{r}
# Estimation des paramètres : méthode des moments
estimer_multi <- function(traj) {
  all_dt <- c(); all_dx <- c()
  for (i in seq_along(traj)) {
    dt <- diff(traj[[i]]$t)
    dx <- diff(traj[[i]]$X)
    all_dt <- c(all_dt, dt)
    all_dx <- c(all_dx, dx)
  }
  mu_hat <- sum(all_dx) / sum(all_dt)
  denom <- sum(all_dt) - sum(all_dt^2)/sum(all_dt)
  nu_hat <- sum((all_dx - mu_hat * all_dt)^2) / denom
  a_hat <- mu_hat^2 / nu_hat
  b_hat <- mu_hat / nu_hat
  return(c(a_hat = a_hat, b_hat = b_hat))
}
```


# Application 1

```{r}
# Simulation des trajectoires
set.seed(73)
simuler_gamma <- function(a, b, temps_obs) {
  delta_t <- diff(c(0, temps_obs))
  delta_X <- rgamma(length(delta_t), shape = a * delta_t, scale = 1/b)
  X <- cumsum(c(0, delta_X))
  list(t = c(0, temps_obs), X = X)
}

t_obs1 <- c(1, 3, 6, 10)
t_obs2 <- c(2, 5, 9)

a = 2
b = 0.5
traj1 <- simuler_gamma(a, b, t_obs1)
traj2 <- simuler_gamma(a, b, t_obs2)
trajectoires <- list(traj1, traj2)

```


```{r}
params <- estimer_multi(trajectoires)
a_hat <- params["a_hat"]
b_hat <- params["b_hat"]
params
```

```{r}
t_fine <- grille(trajectoires)
t_fine 
cat("Pas h =", diff(t_fine)[1], "\n")
```


```{r}

# Pont gamma
res <- pont_gamma_multi(trajectoires, a_hat, t_fine)

# Incréments i.i.d. pour les tests
dx <- unlist(lapply(res, function(x) x$diff_X_iid))
 
```

## Test de Henze

```{r}
library(gofgamma)
test.HME1(dx, a = 1, boot = 200, alpha = 0.05)

```


# Test de villasenor

```{r}
library(goft)

res2 <- gamma_test(dx)
print(res2)
```

```{r}
     xlab = "Temps", ylab = "Dégradation", 
     main = "Points Observés vs Points simulés",
     ylim = range(c(traj1$X, traj2$X, res[[1]]$X_star, res[[2]]$X_star)))
lines(res[[1]]$t_star, res[[1]]$X_star, type = "b", col = "blue", pch = 16)
lines(traj2$t, traj2$X, type = "b", col = "red", pch = 16)
lines(res[[2]]$t_star, res[[2]]$X_star, type = "b", col = "blue", pch = 16)
```

# Apllication 4
```{r}
set.seed(46)

# Fonction de simulation NHGP 
sim_NHGP <- function(t_obs, a, b, alpha) {
  A <- function(t) a * t^alpha
  n <- length(t_obs)
  X <- numeric(n)
  X[1] <- 0
  for (i in 2:n) {
    delta_X <- rgamma(1, shape = A(t_obs[i]) - A(t_obs[i-1]), scale = 1/b)
    X[i] <- X[i-1] + delta_X
  }
  return(data.frame(t = t_obs, X = X))
}

n_traj <- 30            
n_obs <- 25             
alpha <- 2             
a <- 0.5
b <- 1

trajectoires <- list()
for (i in 1:n_traj) {
  t_obs <- sort(runif(n_obs, min = 1, max = 10))
  sim <- sim_NHGP(c(0, t_obs), a = a, b = b, alpha = alpha)
  trajectoires[[i]] <- list(t = sim$t, X = sim$X)
}

# Estimation 
params <- estimer_multi(trajectoires)
a_hat <- params["a_hat"]
b_hat <- params["b_hat"]
cat("a_hat =", a_hat, ", b_hat =", b_hat, "\n")

# Grille commune
t_fine <- grille(trajectoires)

# Pont gamma avec grille commune
res <- pont_gamma_multi(trajectoires, a_hat, t_fine)

# Incréments i.i.d.
dx <- unlist(lapply(res, function(x) x$diff_X_iid))

# Tests d'adéquation 
library(gofgamma)
test.HME1(dx, a = 1, boot = 200, alpha = 0.05)

library(goft)
gamma_test(dx)
```
